gloss: to bill; to charge; to demand

definitions.gloss: to bill; to charge; to invoice
definitions.explanation: To formally request payment for goods or services provided.

definitions.gloss: to demand; to claim; to request formally
definitions.explanation: To make a formal demand or claim, often in a legal or official context.

notes:
Covers both billing/invoicing (sense 1) and formal demands/claims (sense 2). The noun form ⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧ is very common in business and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧: invoice; bill
- {請求額|せいきゅうがく}: billed amount
- {請求先|せいきゅうさき}: billing address; party to be billed
- {損害賠償請求|そんがいばいしょうせいきゅう}: claim for damages
- {不当請求|ふとうせいきゅう}: unjust billing; fraudulent charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}する→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧: to demand — broader, used for any demand including informal ones
- ⟦{催促|さいそく}する→催促する：26806_saisokusuru⟧: to urge payment — focuses on reminding someone to pay or act
- ⟦{徴収|ちょうしゅう}→徴収：16563_choushuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to collect (taxes, fees) — used by authorities collecting payments
